notes: Mind & Belonging: gameId mind-belonging matches registry (export MindBelongingGame). Reworks ModesEngine build onto v2 engine. 84 scenarios faithfully mapped from GDD 49 JSON: 6 cats (settling-in/find-your-people/cope-well/mind-and-self-worth/reach-out/tools-and-help), 7 types (branch 19/strike-rewrite 15/sort 14/reflect 12/role-play 10/spot 7/match 7), 0% binary. College mental health/loneliness/leaving home/body image/help-seeking. 5 modes: settling in (homesickness normalised), find your people, cope well (HEALTHY coping ONLY, body image), reach out (help=strength), tools & crisis routing. HIGH-CARE: distress met with warmth + immediate help route never assessment Qs; healthy coping only (no pain/restriction/shock/self-harm reinforcement); anti-stigma, NOT therapy; serious distress->professionals. India: hostel isolation, academic pressure, stigma esp young men; Tele-MANAS 14416 primary/KIRAN 1800-599-0019/campus counsellors (reassureCats settling-in+cope-well+mind-and-self-worth+reach-out). binStyle: NO change needed (no mis-colors; 'Deepens' is good in mb-083 but bad in mb-008 so deliberately did NOT add a generic deepens token; both-neutral bins are legit when-to-escalate judgment calls). Spot ids injected (7). Builds on g39; continues g42; pairs g48/g52.
